git_tool.system_dll_policy: Windows system DLLs are target-platform inputs

canonical_tree_sha256_spec.path_representation: forward-slash relative path encoded as UTF-8
canonical_tree_sha256_spec.ordering: ascending lexicographic order of UTF-8 path bytes
canonical_tree_sha256_spec.entry_framing: UTF8(path) || NUL || ASCII(decimal byte size) || NUL || ASCII(lowercase file sha256) || LF
canonical_tree_sha256_spec.collision_policy: duplicate canonical paths and Windows case-insensitive path collisions are rejected
canonical_tree_sha256_spec.release_distribution_selection: every path declared by importlib.metadata Distribution.files; every declared path must exist, be prefix-contained, and be a regular non-link/non-reparse file
canonical_tree_sha256_spec.environment_only_selection: existing prefix-contained regular files declared by Distribution.files; missing or outside raw Distribution.files paths are separately frozen
canonical_tree_sha256_spec.missing_or_outside_ordering: ascending lexicographic order of raw Distribution.files path UTF-8 bytes
canonical_tree_sha256_spec.link_policy: any existing symlink or Windows reparse point selected or encountered below sys.prefix is rejected

distribution_inventory.name_normalization: PEP 503: lowercase and collapse each run of hyphen, underscore, or dot to one hyphen

stdlib_tree.file_selection: all recursively installed regular files under root except excluded_subtrees; links/reparse points rejected

site_packages_tree.file_selection: all physical regular files recursively under root, including __pycache__ directories and .pyc files; links/reparse points, duplicate paths, and Windows case-insensitive path collisions are rejected
site_packages_tree.semantics: closes the build-input gap for physical site-packages files not declared by Distribution.files but still discoverable or collectable by PyInstaller

native_runtime_trees.semantics: superset build-input lock for native runtime closure discovery; inclusion does not assert that every locked file is shipped in the installer payload
native_runtime_trees.selection_policy: all selected paths are relative to sys.prefix and use canonical_tree_sha256_spec; missing roots/files, non-regular files, links/reparse points, duplicate paths, and Windows case-insensitive path collisions are rejected

prefix_root_dll_pyd.file_selection: all immediate regular files matching include_suffixes_case_insensitive except excluded_paths

distributions.name: numpy
distributions.license: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0
